blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 48 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (October 12, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: CVVY & MRNA lead 48 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 26 Canadian and 22 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of October 12, 2026) found 48 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 26 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 10 of them new to the list this week. Cavvy Energy Ltd. (CVVY) leads with a +107% six-month return, and Information Technology is the most represented sector with 6 names.

In the U.S., 22 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 9 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +291% six-month return, and Information Technology is the most represented sector with 15 names.
